catalogue_snapshot.freeze_rule: Positions, names, and families reproduce the named entries visible in the official catalogue on the snapshot date. Duplicate official entries remain separate rows.

comparison_policy.rule: Compare documented user outcomes within an explicitly bounded QuickPLS scope; do not claim copied internals, numerical identity, full parity, or SmartPLS project compatibility.
comparison_policy.competitive_scope: All non-legacy catalogue entries are in the QuickPLS 3.0 competitor scope. Legacy Blindfolding and GoF are intentionally deferred and must remain disclosed.
comparison_policy.status_source_of_truth: Capability Registry V2 is the current option-cell authority. Each method-manifest-linked option cell is fail-closed against the live state re-derived from its exact manifest; capability-cell contracts are separately validated by their exact qualification link. The historical parity ledger and generated legacy catalogue are non-authoritative records and projections. Editable row status, source-file references, and historical artifacts cannot promote a claim.

target_releases.objective: Rebuild all source-bound qualification evidence before preserving or promoting any evidence claim.
Establish signed distribution, installer lifecycle certification, and release operations.
Rebuild source-bound engine, archive, native, and release evidence in sequence.
Complete diagnostic and extended-relationship native workflows.
Add power analysis and consistent inference/MGA.
Add model comparison/selection and advanced CB-SEM workflows.
Run the signed external competitor beta.
Publish the competitor-grade stable release after every claim gate passes.
Reassess explicitly deferred legacy or low-value methods.

competitor_claim_gate.applies_to: Every method where competitor_scope is true.
competitor_claim_gate.readiness_rule: Commercial readiness and external-beta graduation are derived only by their fail-closed validators. Final competitor approval is a later non-circular envelope that cryptographically binds the current catalogue, validated reports, external-beta contract, and full method-manifest set; this planning catalogue contains no editable completion flags.
